name: Paper doc comments
oneLiner: a paper doc page lands, two phrases get a highlighter sweep and comment cards swing in from the margin beside them, then a cursor presses the check on one, it fills green, reads Resolved and settles back as its highlight lifts off the text
say: when the speaker talks about feedback on a draft ('my editor left two notes', 'I fixed what they flagged'): the comments land as they name the notes, the green resolve hits on 'fixed' or 'done'
